Paint 3D turns any image into a detailed 3D model. Upload a photo, generate in seconds, download a GLB file ready for games, 3D printing, or product visualization.
Free. No signup. No install.

Try Paint 3D Free
Paint 3D — Image to 3D Generator

Upload an image, generate a 3D model, download the GLB file. First generation may take 30 to 60 seconds while the GPU warms up.

See What Paint 3D Can Create

Paint 3D reads the shape, color, and texture of any image and builds a full 3D model from it. One photo in — a GLB file out, ready to drop into your game, printer, or store.

Game-Ready 3D Assets
Concept art, character sketches, prop photos — upload one and drop the generated model into Unity, Unreal, or Blender.
3D Printing References
Photograph a figurine, a toy, or a product — upload it and get a printable GLB in seconds. Clean base mesh, ready for slicer software.
Product Visualization
Turn a product photo into a 360° rotatable 3D model. Perfect for ecommerce listings, AR previews, and marketing pages.
Avatars & Characters
Drop in a portrait, a sketch, or a character render — get a rig-ready 3D model for VTubing, metaverse, or gaming.
Why Choose Paint 3D

Three reasons Paint 3D beats desktop 3D software and paid services:

Free — Not Freemium
Paint 3D runs on open-source AI. No trial timer, no credit packs, no paywall — unlimited 3D generations, 100% free forever.

Any Browser, Any Device
How Paint 3D Works in 3 Steps

Paint 3D turns an image into a 3D model in under a minute. The flow, start to finish:

1
Upload an Image

Drag a photo in or click to pick one. JPG, PNG, WebP — clear subjects with a plain background work best.

2
Generate the 3D Model

Click Generate. The AI reads your image and builds a mesh with textures in seconds. Pick resolution 512, 1024, or 1536.

3
Download the GLB File

Click Extract GLB. Open it in Blender, Unity, Unreal, or your favorite 3D printing slicer. Use it anywhere GLB is supported.

Paint 3D Features

Six capabilities that make Paint 3D the fastest way to turn images into 3D online:

Image-to-3D AI

Paint 3D reads your photo and builds a full 3D mesh with textures. No modeling skill needed — the AI handles geometry and materials.

GLB File Export

Download the industry-standard GLB format. Works in Blender, Unity, Unreal, Three.js, 3D printers, and AR viewers.

Fast Generation

Standard resolution finishes in about 3 seconds. High-detail models (1024³) in around 17 seconds. No queue for most users.

Choose Your Resolution

Pick 512 for speed, 1024 for balance, or 1536 for maximum detail — mesh quality scales to what you need.

No Signup, No Limits

No account required. No daily cap, no monthly limit, no usage counter. Generate 1 model or 100 — the price stays zero.

Desktop, Tablet, Mobile

Runs on any screen. Generation happens on our servers, so your phone or tablet never breaks a sweat.
